A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research paper and complete Appendices A–D. All 35 pages were compared through text extraction and rendering; pages 2–35 are pixel-identical, and first-page differences concern authorship and dates.

before.justification: v3 reports original classification and scene-understanding experiments in Section 5, with additional calibration, robustness, sensitivity, and qualitative results in Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix D, including benchmark comparisons and supplementary empirical analyses.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain identical SAM perturbations, decomposition into loss and flatness gradients, separate aggregation, and shared/non-shared parameter updates.

E1.justification: The three Multi-MNIST variants, CelebA, NYUv2, CityScapes, and cross-dataset out-of-domain tests in Appendix D.2 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding experiments, including MGDA, PCGrad, CAGrad, IMTL, STL, and the additional baselines in Tables 2–4. Appendix D retains the same IMTL versus F-IMTL comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix C retain the same architectures, preprocessing, training budgets, evaluation metrics, and final-ten-epoch averaging. Supplementary testing procedures also match.

E4.justification: The aggregation ablation, parameter-noise robustness test, calibration analyses, segmentation examples, and sensitivity, gradient, and loss-landscape analyses in Section 5.3 and Appendix D are identical.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains identical uncertainty reporting. Appendix C.3 still specifies three random seeds, and Figure 10 still reports error bars from three independent runs.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–7 and quantitative and qualitative results in Figures 2–17 match. No results, rankings, or reported findings are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: Theorem 1, the gradient derivations, and Appendix A's Theorems 2–4 and proofs are unchanged. The mathematical definitions and assumptions also match.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about incorporating flat-minimum seeking into gradient-based multi-task learning to improve generalization, robustness, and calibration.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning gradient conflict, flatness, calibration, task tradeoffs, and CityScapes void-region behavior are unchanged. No substantive limitations or qualifications are added.

D1.justification: Appendix C retains identical backbone and head descriptions, optimizer schedules, batch sizes, image resizing, and perturbation-radius tuning details. Implementation and resource-access disclosures are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the positioning relative to SAM and previous multi-task learning methods, and all 80 bibliography entries are unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 adds Qi Lei to the author list, changes the title-page date from November 20, 2024 to May 26, 2025, and updates the arXiv version/date marking. Research prose, headings, and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page author block is reflowed to accommodate Qi Lei, moving Tuan Truong to the first author line. All figures, tables, captions, and subsequent page layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: v4 changes authorship and date/version information, with a small author-block layout adjustment. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, proofs, implementation details, and explanatory prose remain identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
